title: Master of Manticores (1458)
problem: The +15% Attack / Defense loop gives the bonus only to party members whose race is Manticore. The enemy −5% Attack part is fine.
notes: Community claim: Only Manticores get the bonus, though the text says "your creatures". Evidence: bc_StartupStatGain: scr_AnyAllyHasPassive(1458) @0x14174e6ef; crits[i].race == "Manticore" @0x14174e8dd, skip je 0x14174f29d @0x14174e900 (bytes 0f 84 97 09 00 00); enemy mirror @0x14174f5ed / je @0x14174f610. Fix sketch: NOP the two race-skip jumps @0x14174e900 and @0x14174f610 (S). Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Only Manticores get the +15%. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "your creatures have 15% more Attack and Defense for each Manticore". Fix: S: NOP the race-skip jumps in bc_StartupStatGain: @0x14174e900 (L1179, your side) and @0x14174f610 (L1189, enemy side), 0f8497090000 -> 660f1f440000; the count is a separate bc_CountRace call. vs bugged: stronger (every creature on the side). 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0169 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: Your creatures get 15% more Attack and Defense for each Manticore on your side.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only Manticores got the bonus.
release_notes.fix: Now every creature on the side gets it.
